opening.argument: The speaker directly ties success to maximizing the OneCoin compensation plan, becoming a top earner, and recruiting others “pretty much effortlessly.” The opportunity is framed around “financial freedom” and “prosperity,” while a recruiting bootcamp is promoted as creating “an endless flow of red hot ready to join leads” so viewers can “recruit an army into one coin.” These are not incidental references to a product or independent business service. The central earning pathway presented is recruitment within OneCoin’s compensation and distributor structure, with prosperity linked to building that recruitment base.
